'''Adrián Blas Taffarel''' (born 10 January 1966) is an Argentine football [[Manager (association football)|manager]] and former player who played as a [[Forward (association football)|forward]]. He is the current manager of the Argentinian Regional League Club [[Sport Club Cañadense]].

==Playing career==
A [[Newell's Old Boys]] youth graduate, Taffarel made his first team debut in September 1988, and was a part of the squad which won the [[1990–91 Argentine Primera División]], even though he ended the campaign at [[Chaco For Ever]]. In 1991, he joined [[Ferro Carril Oeste]] also in the top tier, and played for a brief period for [[Club Atlético Banfield|Banfield]] in 1993.

In 1995, after a year with [[Gimnasia y Tiro]], Taffarel moved abroad and joined Mexican side [[C.D. Irapuato|Irapuato]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://laferropedia.com/jugador-1211/|title=Adrián Blas Taffarel|publisher=La Ferropedia|language=es|accessdate=22 October 2021}}</ref> In 1997, he played in the [[Primera B de Chile]] for [[O'Higgins F.C.|O'Higgins]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ohigginsfc.cl/historia.php?id=6|title=Historia|trans-title=History|publisher=O'Higgins FC|language=es|accessdate=22 October 2021}}</ref> before returning to his home country with [[Argentino de Rosario]]. He retired in 1998, aged 32.

==Managerial career==
Immediately after retiring Taffarel took up coaching, being manager of CA San Martín de Chovet before returning to Newell's in 1999, as a youth coach. He was also a manager of former side Argentino de Rosario in 2002, and was in charge of CR Unión y Cultura de Murphy in 2001 to 2004 and in 2016, [[Jorge Newbery de Comodoro Rivadavia]] in 2013, back at San Martín in 2015 and Club Sportivo María Teresa in 2018.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.redboing.com/lo-que-tenes-que-saber-de-adrian-blas-taffarel-nuevo-dt-de-newells/|title=Lo que tenés que saber de Adrián Blas Taffarel nuevo DT de Newell’s|trans-title=What you need to know about Adrián Blas Taffarel new manager of Newell's|publisher=Red Boing|language=es|date=18 October 2021|accessdate=22 October 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.diarioelinforme.com.ar/2019/01/09/piersimone-la-humildad-de-los-directivos-me-dio-ganas-de-estar-aca|title=Piersimone: La humildad de los directivos me dio ganas de estar acá|trans-title=Piersimone: The humbleness of the board members gave me eagerness to be here|publisher=El Informe|language=es|date=9 January 2019|accessdate=22 October 2021}}</ref>

Taffarel returned to Newell's and their youth categories in 2019. On 18 October 2021, after [[Fernando Gamboa]] was sacked, he was named interim manager until the end of the tournament.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newellsoldboys.com.ar/noticias/primera-division/2021/10/18/Comunicado-oficial-18-10-21-00-36|title=Comunicado oficial|trans-title=Official announcement|publisher=Newell's Old Boys|language=es|date=18 October 2021|accessdate=22 October 2021|archive-date=26 October 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211026055734/https://www.newellsoldboys.com.ar/noticias/primera-division/2021/10/18/Comunicado-oficial-18-10-21-00-36|url-status=dead}}</ref> He returned to the youth sides shortly after, before leaving the club in 2022.

On 7 February 2023, Taffarel moved abroad and was named manager of [[Peruvian Segunda División]] side [[Unión Huaral]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://libero.pe/futbol-peruano/2023/02/06/union-huaral-sorprende-todos-fichar-entrenador-dirigio-newells-old-boys-387336|title=Unión Huaral sorprende a todos al fichar entrenador que dirigió al Newells Old Boys|trans-title=Unión Huaral surprise everyone by signing the manager who managed Newells Old Boys|publisher=Líbero|language=es|date=6 February 2023|accessdate=17 July 2023}}</ref> On 15 June, he took over [[Academia Deportiva Cantolao|Cantolao]] in the country's [[Peruvian Primera División|Primera División]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ovacion.pe/noticias/academia-cantolao/agarro-timon-adrian-taffarel-entreno-primera-vez-academia-cantolao|title=¡Agarró el timón!  Adrián Taffarel entrenó por primera vez con la Academia Cantolao|trans-title=He took the helm! Adrián Taffarel trained for the first time with Academia Cantolao|publisher=Ovación|language=es|date=15 June 2023|access-date=4 July 2023}}</ref>

On 19 december 2024, Taffarel was presented as [[Sport Club Cañadense]] manager, team that plays in [[Liga Cañadense de Futbol]] (Argentinian 5th tier)
